To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a novel strategy, MixNeighborhood, for learning preferences of cold-start items in a recommender system; (2) we evaluate the strategy on a dataset of music preferences of Last.fm users and show that it outperforms the state of the art; (3) we show that the strategy can also be applied in the cold-start user setting and that it outperformed the state of the-art in that setting as well.

(a) we model the learning problem of cold-start users in a social network as a bandit problem, (b) we propose two new bandit algorithms for the cold-start problem, and (c) our experiments show that our proposed strategies outperform the baseline by a large margin, learning 2-5 times faster.
